ticket: TTLS-R1 unified test-time learned steering pilot (exploratory)

subgroup.use: targeted descriptive subgroup; never a population estimate

population.role: already-exposed D-dev-select fixed-100 (subset of the documented FULL300 exposure); no new exposure

site.repair: models.hooks.apply_steering NormPreserve, alpha=scale=1, no sqrt(L) rescale

LN.what: historical A2 actuator unchanged (episodic_tta): 194 decoder LayerNorm affine tensors
LN.masters: fresh fp32 from theta0, bf16 forward via functional_call

TTLS.what: one temporary fp32 vector z in R^1280 at the L16 DG-02 site: r~_t = NormPreserve(r_t + g_t z)

budget.projection: after every step z <- z * min(1, E_STAR/||z||)
budget.source: frozen DG-02 L16 realized chord (P2/DIR-SPRINT0), about 15% of ||r||

TTLS.reset: new zero z and new optimizer per utterance and per arm; the hook exists only inside one forward/decode call

masks.CE: ALL editable steps (t >= 1): the CE objective has no localization signal; the global mask is the closest activation-space analogue of A2's shared parameters
masks.AC: {t*}: the first accepted acoustic-lexical candidate step
masks.deviation: The proposed first AUTO/forced disagreement region is structurally unusable on this panel (reference-free design-time finding): forced and AUTO differ on 12/100 rows and the first token differs at content step 0 on 12/12 (leading-space artifact or whole-utterance translation); step 0 is a DG-02 forced-prefix position that is never edited.

objectives.CE: historical A2: mean over valid y_A positions of -log p_theta(y_A[t] | cB, y_A[:t]) (episodic_tta.position_terms + objective_loss('A2'))
objectives.AC: -log p_theta(c* | cB, y_B[:t*]) at the first accepted candidate; no accepted candidate => exact abstention (output = B0)
objectives.P: + LAMBDA_P * mean_{t in S} KL(p_theta0,t || p_theta,t) on the B0 path y_B under cB over the allowed vocabulary (soft_auto_tta.allowed_log_probs/kl_terms)
objectives.note: KL to theta0 has zero gradient at theta0, so P acts on the second update only (two-step budget)

candidate_rule.branches: teacher-forced on the B0 path y_B: clean/null audio x cB/cE prompts, frozen theta0, computed before any adaptation
candidate_rule.null_audio: 30 s of zeros through the same feature extractor and encoder (DIR-SPRINT0 D3 null)
candidate_rule.structural: 1 <= t < |y_B|, UTF-8-complete prefix y_B[:t], b_t not EOS and not embedded-Latin
candidate_rule.proposal: e_t = argmax cE_clean log-prob at t (lowest ID on ties); language-disagreement step iff e_t embedded-Latin (=> e_t != b_t); M = all such steps
candidate_rule.evidence: A^c(v) = l^c_clean(v) - max(l^c_null(v), log 1e-12); E^c = A^c(e_t) - A^c(b_t) for c in {cB, cE}
candidate_rule.accept: E^cB >= tau and E^cE >= tau (prompt-robust acoustic support)
candidate_rule.target: t* = first accepted step, c* = e_t*

stable_set.rule: valid content steps t of y_B with p_theta0(b_t) >= 0.5 under cB and t not in M

arms.B0: forced-ZH greedy (reused P2-SEQ S0; reproduced in-job)
arms.B1: AUTO greedy (reused; replayed in-job with the historical detect_language prompt)
arms.B2: historical A2 = AUTO pseudo-CE on LN (reused TTA1/TTA0-R outputs; decoded in-job from archived fp32 masters)
arms.T2A: A2-CE+P (added matched comparator so P is not a TTLS-only advantage)

CD.what: no-update full-sequence acoustic-contrastive decoding: frozen DIR-SPRINT0 D3 rule (dir_sprint0.d3_candidate) at every step t >= 1 with a UTF-8-complete prefix whose clean greedy token is not EOS

legal_static.definition: token IDs < 50257 (EOS), not in generation_config.suppress_tokens, not special, whose byte string is UTF-8-boundary legal (first byte not 0x80-0xBF; strict decode succeeds or fails only with 'unexpected end of data' at the end)

comparators.ACSUB: no-update: the accepted candidate c* substituted at t* (prefix y_B[:t*]), then ordinary forced-ZH greedy; abstain => B0

evaluation.primary: free decoding only; canonical csasr.evaluation (PIER, MER, EN-WER, ZH-CER, POI transitions, retention, outside harm)
evaluation.references: opened only after the committed output seal
evaluation.eos_recovery_row: B0 terminated eos and B0 tokens are a strict prefix of the system tokens
evaluation.premature_eos_row: system terminated eos and system tokens are a strict prefix of B0 tokens

label_rule.INVALID: any integrity failure: missing/failed row, B0/B1/B2 reuse identity mismatch, failed in-job validation, reset or non-LN change
label_rule.PROMISING: some TTLS arm X in {T1,T2,T4,T6} with matched A2 arm Y has (a) >= 8 genuine-substitution POI corrections vs B0 in >= 4 dialogues, (b) all safety bounds vs B0, and (c) genuine-substitution corrections(X) >= (Y) and newly introduced Mandarin errors(X) <= (Y)
label_rule.MIXED: not PROMISING and some TTLS arm has >= 3 genuine-substitution corrections vs B0 and net POI corrections (corrections - corruptions) > 0
label_rule.AUTO: comparison with B1 is reported for every arm but does not enter the label
